description: Na₈Mg(FeO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.70 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.56 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.49 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.50 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.40 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.75 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond length. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids and corners with four FeO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.03 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-1.94 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-1.96 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Fe atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Fe atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-67°. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Fe atom to form corner-sharing ONa₅Fe octahedra. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Fe atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Fe atom.
